root_idea.summary: The root centers on youthful newness and the stirring or intensification of sexual desire.
root_idea.development: The lexicon connects the young male غُلَام with the state of youth, while related verbal and nominal forms express sexual arousal, maturation, causation, and figurative excess. Other derivatives extend to specialized descriptions of people, animals, liquids, and places.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The group is a Quran-attested nominal lexical item and is presented under the normalized citation form غُلَامٌ.

senses.definition: A boy or young male; in a kinship context, a young son.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form occurs in singular, dual, and plural contexts. Translations such as “boy” and “son” reflect the surrounding situation rather than separate lexical senses. A broader Classical extension to a middle-aged man is listed separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become sexually aroused, overcome by lust, or vehemently affected by carnal desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a man, girl, or young woman; also said of a male camel when it becomes aroused to mate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To excite sexual appetite; of a beverage, to strengthen the venereal faculty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative use applied to a thing or, in a specialized expression, to a beverage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a boy, to reach the stage called غُلُومَةٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited description associates this stage approximately with the seventeenth year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a beverage or wine, to become strong in its influence upon the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of the effect of a beverage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the sea, to become stirred into commotion, with its waves dashing together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended description of turbulent water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exceed the prescribed limit, whether in good or in evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended figurative use concerning excess beyond an established norm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lustful, sexually excited, or vehemently affected by desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a male or female, and particularly to a he-camel in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persons confined, restricted, or imprisoned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare plural expression whose singular is not specified in the cited passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lust, appetence, or carnal desire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote desire experienced by young men, desire in women, or a camel’s lust to mate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man of middle age, by an extended application of the term.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Classical extension is distinct from the Quranic young-male use; the cited evidence also reports broad applications ranging from a newborn child to a middle-aged man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A male slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended Classical use of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hireling or servant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended service-related use, distinct from the age meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state or period of being a غُلَامٌ; traditionally, the period from birth to about the seventeenth year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the age or condition associated with a young male.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beautiful woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use of غَيْلَمٌ distinct from its other specialized meanings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A broad or large-bodied young man with abundant hair at the parting of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a youth or young man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression مَا بِالدَّارِ غَيْلَمٌ, any person or anyone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning occurs in a fixed expression meaning that there is no one in the house.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tortoise, especially a male tortoise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological use; some authorities extend the term to the tortoise generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A frog.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological use reported alongside an alternative form عَيْلَمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place from which water issues in wells.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A term for a feature or source of a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most exciting to lust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective, used of something regarded as especially stimulating sexual desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause or stimulus of lust, or of vehement lust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited evidence illustrates the term with a beverage, but the definition is not limited to that example.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a beverage or wine, strong in its influence upon the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival description of the effect of stored drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An exceeder of the prescribed limit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended figurative use; the cited expression applies it to a religious deviator, but the definition is broader.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Beverage becoming strong in its effect on the head.
Noun for lust or carnal desire.
Young-male noun and its reported middle-aged extension.
State or period of being a ghulam.
Specialized description of a broad, hirsute youth.
Source of water in a well.
Editorial correction identifying the word as فَيْلَم rather than غَيْلَم.
Pointer to the preceding غَيْلَم entry.
Comparative or superlative excitation of lust.
Wine or beverage strong in its effect on the head.

cautions: The age range of غُلَامٌ is not fixed uniformly in the Classical evidence; the Quranic young-male sense is therefore kept distinct from the reported middle-aged extension.

The Mufradat text labels its discussion of the wall belonging to two boys with يوسف 19, whereas the supplied QAC occurrence is securely located at 18:82; the QAC location is used here without converting the discrepant citation.
